title: AudioFrame
description: A single frame of audio on the data plane. This JSON Schema is the validatable mirror of AudioFrame in contracts/grpc/v1/common.proto, and the fixture format for the ADR-0027 sensory harness — the mechanism that makes the entire voice pipeline testable in CI with no microphone attached.

compatibility.notes: MUST STAY IN STEP WITH common.proto — protobuf is the wire format, this is the mirror. Changing sample_rate_hz defaults is MAJOR in practice even though the schema permits any value: every trained model (wake word, STT) assumes 16 kHz capture, and a mismatch degrades accuracy silently rather than erroring.
compatibility.wire_format: protobuf (lionel.v1.AudioFrame). This schema is for validation, fixtures and documentation, never for live transport.

payload_policy.rule: ADR-0006. On the CONTROL PLANE, only the descriptor travels — `payload_b64` MUST be absent. It may be populated ONLY in test fixtures and on the data plane, where the protobuf `bytes payload` field carries it as binary.
payload_policy.why: Base64 inflates by ~33% on the highest-volume path in the system, and a control plane carrying PCM has no backpressure, no jitter buffer and head-of-line blocking behind unrelated tool calls.
payload_policy.enforcement: The contracts CI invariant check asserts payload_b64 never appears in a control-plane schema or a live control-plane payload.

seq.description: Monotonic from 0 within a stream. A GAP IS LEGITIMATE, not an error: ADR-0025 requires the data plane to apply backpressure by DROPPING frames and never by blocking, because a blocked data plane stalls the control plane. Consumers detect gaps and conceal, they do not abort.

timestamp_ns.description: Nanoseconds since STREAM START — relative, not wall clock. Wall-clock skew between host and cluster would corrupt jitter calculations at L2.

end_of_utterance.description: Set on the final frame so the receiver finalizes immediately rather than waiting out a timeout.

payload_b64.description: FIXTURES AND DATA PLANE ONLY. See x-lionel.payload_policy. Absent on the control plane, always.

payload_bytes.description: Length of the frame payload. Present even when payload_b64 is absent, so a descriptor still describes something.

source.description: `fixture` marks harness-injected audio. The L0 conformance suite asserts that a CI run sees only `fixture`, which is how 'tested without hardware' is proven rather than assumed.

sentence_boundary.description: TTS output only. Lets the player start on sentence 1 while sentence 2 is still rendering — the 300 ms first-audio budget assumes this.

sample_rate_hz.description: 16000 capture and STT · 24000 Kokoro · 22050 Piper. Resampling between them is the TTS service's job, not the player's.

channels.description: Mono only. Stereo capture is not supported and would not help — wake word, VAD and STT are all single-channel models.

codec.description: opus is reserved for L2 over constrained links; unused at L0/L1.

frame_ms.description: 80 on the capture path. 10/20/30 exist because VAD implementations commonly require one of those.
